name: Isometric Farm Pack
projection: 2:1 dimetric (isometric) – tile diamond is twice as wide as it is tall

conventions.world: tile x runs screen down-right, tile y runs screen down-left
conventions.anchor: pixel inside the image that sits on the footprint's TOP (north) corner of tile (tx,ty) – for animals: the ground point under the animal. Use origin=[ax/w, ay/h] with Phaser setOrigin().
conventions.screen_position: screenX = originX + (tx - ty) * tileWidth/2 ; screenY = originY + (tx + ty) * tileHeight/2
conventions.depth: sort objects by (tx + ty + footprintW + footprintH) or by the screen Y of their footprint's bottom corner; draw all shadow layers below sprites
conventions.directions: se = toward +x, sw = toward +y, ne = toward -y, nw = toward -x
